description: Create a brand-new, freeform, multi-section Notion page under a parent page from an LLM-extraction dict. Every materialization creates a NEW page -- not an update against one fixed page_id (see notion_page_sync) and not a database row upsert (see notion_database_upsert).

inputs.description: Upstream asset value: a dict containing a structured-fields sub-dict under `extracted_field` (e.g. agentic_pipeline's `extract` op output: {text, extracted, model, ...}).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata. No downstream data -- the write side effect lands in Notion as a brand-new page.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream Dagster asset producing the LLM-extraction dict (single upstream only).

extracted_field.label: Extracted Field
extracted_field.description: Key of the upstream dict holding the structured fields dict. Matches agentic_pipeline's `extract` op output shape: {text, extracted, model, ...}.

parent_page_id.label: Parent Page Id
parent_page_id.description: Notion page ID the new page is created under (UUID with or without dashes). Standalone-page target only -- no database/property-schema support.

title_template.label: Title Template
title_template.description: Template for the new page's title, substituted against the extracted dict's fields via plain str.replace('{field}', value) -- not .format -- so unrelated literal braces survive unresolved. Example: 'Brief: {company_name}'.

sections.label: Sections
sections.description: Explicit section list, each {heading: str, field: str, format: 'paragraph'|'bulleted_list'}. `field` names a key in the extracted dict. paragraph renders the value as one paragraph block under a heading_2 (lists are newline-joined); bulleted_list requires a list value and renders one bulleted_list_item block per element. Omit/empty to auto-build sections from whichever keys are present in the extracted dict.

markdown_body_field.label: Markdown Body Field
markdown_body_field.description: Key in the extracted dict holding free-form markdown to append as a final section, if present. Rendered via a crude paragraph-per-blank-line split -- not full markdown parsing. Set to null to disable.

icon_emoji.label: Icon Emoji
icon_emoji.description: Emoji to set as the new page's icon, e.g. '📄'. Passed as icon={type: emoji, emoji: ...}.

receipts.label: Receipts
receipts.description: Optional provenance recording: {resource_key: str, caller_id: str|null, policy_version: str|null}. When set, records a context_receipt_store retrieval receipt after page creation succeeds, and surfaces the resulting receipt_id in output metadata.

name: Notion Brief Page
